descriptions.text: Upgrade Patch. Small. This patch depicts a peace symbol. Ahh, isn't that cute? Buzz off, dirty hippie. Go be smelly somewhere else. The Grateful Dead sucked. And so does Phish. If this upgrade patch is affixed to an eligible garment, it will imbue the following upgrades: Neutral mobs are less likely to fall into aggro. +10% to Dexterity. +10% skill in playing the bongos. Warning: Upgrade patches are fleeting items. You may remove them, but they will be destroyed in the process.

recap.text: Carl sews a round, black-and-white screen-printed peace symbol onto the bottom of his jacket, next to the bomb symbol, before he attaches the celestial back patch. He does the small patch first to be doubly certain the back patch's effect catches every regular patch. It is his fifth, after the earth symbol, the arrows, the bomb symbol and the anti-vampire Midnight Epicure patch, and each patch adds one point to all his stats.

Carl zaps a level-1 tummy acher onto the table, half the size of his fist, with a spattering of black hairs on its head, Garret's underbite and a single round tooth. The first one Carl ever saw wore a red tag, and this one does not. He cannot tell whether that is because it used to be Ren's pet or because of his peace symbol patch and his higher charisma.

beats.headline: Buzz off, dirty hippie
beats.text: In the line of boxes from the last floor, the gold pacifist's box holds a small upgrade patch for Carl's jacket, a round peace symbol, and Donut scoffs at the quality. It is almost the size of his earth patch, black with a white, screen-printed peace symbol. The description tells him to buzz off, dirty hippie, and says the Grateful Dead sucked, and so does Phish. Carl calls that unnecessarily rude. Donut does not like Phish either: Angel the cocker spaniel's owner was always listening to them.
beats.gist: Carl's jacket gets a black, screen-printed peace symbol patch that tells hippies to buzz off, and Donut scoffs.

beats.headline: Sewn on first
beats.text: Before the celestial back patch goes on, Carl sews the peace symbol onto the bottom of his jacket next to the bomb symbol. He does the small one first, to be doubly certain the back patch's effect catches every regular patch. It is his fifth, after the earth symbol, the arrows, the bomb symbol and the anti-vampire Midnight Epicure patch, and every patch on the jacket adds one point to all his stats.
beats.gist: Carl sews the peace symbol onto his jacket first, his fifth patch, so the back patch counts it.

beats.headline: A meatball that is not red

The first of these things Carl ever saw was red-tagged. This one is not, and he does not know whether that is because it used to be Ren's pet or because of his peace symbol patch plus his higher charisma.
beats.gist: Carl zaps a tummy acher onto the table; this one is not red-tagged.
